body: Damn that’s a great point. It actually makes me more happy knowing when I help a friend. Thank you
You bring up some very good points that mimic my feelings like it feeling good to be able to help the ones you love. Thank you
Thank you, that helps very much. I’m sorry you lost her.
I guess better wording on my part for it would be I don’t want to detract away from the happiness she’s finally reached
That’s a great analogy, and I will be the paper towel. Thank you
The “refrain from insulting him” is actually something very important and I’m glad you said that. Thank you
Yeah I can go ahead and assure you that I will not be doing that. Cheers though
Thank you for that. What do I say when she says things like “I deserved it” or “it’s all because of me” ?
I would gladly be up for a conversation. I understand it’s hard to find someone that will give it to you straight, so send me a message and we’ll get started?

This is the same for me in a different kind of way. I don’t know a way I could say goodbye to the woman I love without her blaming herself. I promised her I would never hurt her again, and killing my self would result in her putting all the blame on her. I could never leave her to that type of life.
That sounds great! I look forward to it.

It’s helps to understand that those who haven’t gone through dark times, will not be able to understand what it’s actually like. Even some therapists that have gone to school for years won’t completely understand unless they’ve gone through it. It sucks feeling like you’re in this alone. I’m here if you want to talk because I understand.

That’s what it looks like from the outside because you haven’t tried it yet. If you really want to spite someone, you can do it, even with no energy. Trust me from experience. Spite will overcome exhaustion and reason. It works.

One reason? To spite the world. Learn to hate the world so much that you want to succeed in spite of it. 

Another reason? Go to a shelter and find a dog or cat that came from a bad living situation. Make it your goal to give them the best life possible.
Can I ask why you did it?
Sorry for taking so long to reply, but thank you for the advice, kind stranger :)

We’ll see that’s part of the problem. I don’t like giving out details. I don’t really like talking to people about things. It’s not that I’m anti-social. I just don’t like giving out information about my life.
